decisions.reason: Ending the comparison-proof workflow does not change the established Hero V geometry attributes; the same-message failure and cessation of revision work are already represented separately.
The source reports failure to preserve the second V and ends further revisions, but it does not replace or cancel any current second-V construction rule.
The source confirms that the latest examples violated the locked hierarchy but does not establish a new height relationship or make any existing hierarchy attribute obsolete.
The project-conclusion decision does not alter the established architectural requirements for the E and L letterforms.
The source does not change or rescind the requirement that the É accent be literally derived from the Hero V terminal.
Removing further comparison proofs does not change the established Hero-V-to-accent peak-alignment rule.
The source ends future design revisions but does not modify the accepted formats for any review images that are delivered.
The project conclusion does not change the selected Balanced Flow kerning or the wordmark's spacing goals.
The source does not alter the selected distribution of champagne gold across the signature elements.
The conclusion of revision work does not replace or remove the selected Satin Reflection finish attributes.
The source does not change the established shared-baseline alignment rule.
The source's handoff effect is already fully represented by the existing same-message MODIFY, including replacement of the production-ready standard with delivery of all files as currently existing.
